M("div",{className:"min-h-screen bg-[#050507] text-zinc-100 selection:bg-violet-500/30",children:[k("style",{children:`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
        * { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
        .mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

        /* Noise background */
        .noise {
          position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.03;
          background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
        }

        /* Star wrapper - maintains exact aspect 135x159 */
        .star-wrapper {
          position: relative;
          width: 64px;
          height: 75.5px;
          will-change: transform, filter;
        }
        .star-stack {
          position: relative;
          width: 100%; height: 100%;
          transform-origin: center;
        }
        .layer {
          position: absolute; inset: 0;
          will-change: transform, filter, opacity;
        }
        .shadow-layer {
          background: black;
          transform: translate(2px, 2px);
          filter: blur(8px);
          opacity: 0.5;
        }
        .cavity-layer {
          background: radial-gradient(80% 80% at 50% 35%, #1A1A1E 0%, #0A0A0A 100%);
        }
        .main-layer {
          background-size: 200% 200% !important;
          background-position: 0% 50%;
        }
        .bevel-layer {
          background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.4) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 20%, transparent 60%);
          mix-blend-mode: overlay;
        }
        .bevel-layer::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute; inset: 0;
          border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
          filter: blur(0.3px);
          /* outline as border inside mask trick */
          box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
        }
        .highlight-layer {
          background: radial-gradient(60% 45% at 35% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
          filter: blur(0.5px);
        }
        .core-glow {
          position: absolute;
          left: 50%; top: 50%;
          width: 22%; height: 22%;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
          background: white;
          border-radius: 50%;
          filter: blur(6px);
          opacity: 0;
        }
        .ambient-glow {
          position: absolute;
          inset: -18px;
          border-radius: 30%;
          filter: blur(18px);
          opacity: 0.22;
          z-index: -1;
          background-size: 200% 200% !important;
          will-change: transform, opacity;
        }

        /* Internal particles */
        .internal-particles { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
        .int-dot {
          position: absolute;
          width: 5px; height: 5px;
          background: white;
          border-radius: 50%;
          box-shadow: 0 0 6px white, 0 0 12px currentColor;
          opacity: 0.9;
        }
        .int-dot-1 { left: 52%; top: 46%; color: #A78BFA; }
        .int-dot-2 { left: 38%; top: 58%; color: #F472B6; width: 4px; height: 4px; }
        .int-dot-3 { left: 62%; top: 62%; color: #60A5FA; width: 3.5px; height: 3.5px; }

        /* External dots - orbit ellipse */
        .external-dots { position: absolute; inset: -14px; pointer-events: none; }
        .ext-dot { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 0; height: 0; }
        .ext-dot-inner {
          width: 6px; height: 6px;
          background: white;
          border-radius: 50%;
          box-shadow: 0 0 8px white, 0 0 14px currentColor;
          transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        }
        .ext-dot-1 .ext-dot-inner { background: #3B82F6; color: #3B82F6; }
        .ext-dot-2 .ext-dot-inner { background: #06B6D4; color: #06B6D4; width: 5px; height: 5px; }
        .ext-dot-3 .ext-dot-inner { background: #10B981; color: #10B981; width: 4px; height: 4px; }

        /* Rings */
        .rings-container { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
        .ring {
          position: absolute;
          width: 78px; height: 90px;
          border: 1.2px solid;
          border-radius: 45% / 50%;
          opacity: 0;
        }
        .ring-1 { border-color: rgba(59,130,246,0.5); }
        .ring-2 { border-color: rgba(6,182,214,0.35); }
        .ring-3 { border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.28); }

        /* ===== ANIMATIONS ===== */

        /* Cloud Low: slow morph 1 -> 1.03, glow pulse */
        .anim-cloud-low .star-stack { animation: cloudLowMorph 4.8s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-low .core-glow { animation: glowPulse 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-low .ambient-glow { animation: ambientPulse 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-low .main-layer { animation: gradientShift 4.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-low .int-dot-1 { animation: orbitSlow 5.5s linear infinite; }

        @keyframes cloudLowMorph {
          0% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
          100% { transform: scale(1.03, 1.02) rotate(0.6deg); }
        }

        /* Web Gentle: scanning ring + edge reflection */
        .anim-web-gentle .ring-1 { animation: ringScan 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite; }
        .anim-web-gentle .main-layer { animation: gradientShift 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate, edgeSweep 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
        .anim-web-gentle .ambient-glow { animation: ambientPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }

        @keyframes ringScan {
          0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
          20% { opacity: 0.6; }
          80% { opacity: 0.2; }
          100% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes edgeSweep {
          0% { filter: brightness(1); }
          50% { filter: brightness(1.22) saturate(1.1); }
          100% { filter: brightness(1); }
        }

        /* Cloud HIGH - favorite */
        .anim-cloud-high .star-stack { animation: cloudHighSquash 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-high .main-layer { animation: gradientShiftFast 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-high .core-glow { animation: glowHigh 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; background: #E040FB; }
        .anim-cloud-high .ambient-glow { animation: ambientHigh 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; filter: blur(22px); }
        .anim-cloud-high .int-dot-1 { animation: orbitFast 1.1s linear infinite; }
        .anim-cloud-high .int-dot-2 { animation: orbitFast 1.1s linear infinite reverse; animation-delay: -0.35s; }
        .anim-cloud-high .int-dot-3 { animation: orbitFastInner 1.1s linear infinite; animation-delay: -0.7s; }

        @keyframes cloudHighSquash {
          0% { transform: scale(1, 1) translateY(0); }
          25% { transform: scale(0.92, 1.12) translateY(-1px); }
          50% { transform: scale(1.12, 0.9) translateY(1px); }
          100% { transform: scale(0.98, 1.04) translateY(-0.5px); }
        }
        @keyframes glowHigh {
          0% { opacity: 0.35; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.9); filter: blur(6px); }
          100% { opacity: 0.7; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.4); filter: blur(9px); }
        }
        @keyframes ambientHigh {
          0% { opacity: 0.28; transform: scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0.48; transform: scale(1.15); }
        }
        @keyframes orbitFast {
          0% { transform: rotate(0deg) translateX(14px) rotate(0deg); }
          100% { transform: rotate(360deg) translateX(14px) rotate(-360deg); }
        }
        @keyframes orbitFastInner {
          0% { transform: rotate(0deg) translateX(9px) rotate(0deg); }
          100% { transform: rotate(-360deg) translateX(9px) rotate(360deg); }
        }

        /* Hybrid: vertical flow + external writing */
        .anim-hybrid .main-layer { animation: verticalFlow 2.2s linear infinite; }
        .anim-hybrid .star-stack { animation: cloudLowMorph 3.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-hybrid .ext-dot-1 { animation: borderWrite 2.2s linear infinite; }
        .anim-hybrid .ext-dot-1 .ext-dot-inner { background: #F472B6; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #F472B6; }

        @keyframes verticalFlow {
          0% { background-position: 50% 0%; filter: hue-rotate(0deg) brightness(1); }
          100% { background-position: 50% 200%; filter: hue-rotate(12deg) brightness(1.08); }
        }
        @keyframes borderWrite {
          0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg) translateY(-44px); }
          100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg) translateY(-44px); }
        }

        /* Web HIGH - second favorite */
        .anim-web-high .main-layer { animation: gradientSpin 3.4s linear infinite; }
        .anim-web-high .ring-1 { animation: ringPulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite; }
        .anim-web-high .ring-2 { animation: ringPulse 2.7s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite 0.3s; }
        .anim-web-high .ring-3 { animation: ringPulse 3.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite 0.6s; }
        .anim-web-high .ext-dot-1 { animation: ellipseOrbit 2s linear infinite; }
        .anim-web-high .ext-dot-2 { animation: ellipseOrbit 2.7s linear infinite; animation-delay: -0.9s; }
        .anim-web-high .ext-dot-3 { animation: ellipseOrbit 3.4s linear infinite; animation-delay: -1.7s; }

        @keyframes gradientSpin {
          0% { background-position: 0% 50%; filter: hue-rotate(0deg); }
          100% { background-position: 200% 50%; filter: hue-rotate(20deg); }
        }
        @keyframes ringPulse {
          0% { transform: scale(0.75); opacity: 0; }
          15% { opacity: 0.5; }
          100% { transform: scale(1.55); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes ellipseOrbit {
          0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg) translate(38px, 0) rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
          50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(180deg) translate(44px, -8px) rotate(-180deg) scale(1.15); }
          100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(360deg) translate(38px, 0) rotate(-360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        /* Cloud Minimal: dual breathing */
        .anim-cloud-minimal .star-stack { animation: breathA 3.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate, breathB 4.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-cloud-minimal .main-layer { animation: gradientShift 4.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate; filter: saturate(0.2) brightness(0.9); }
        .anim-cloud-minimal .ambient-glow { opacity: 0.12; filter: blur(14px); animation: ambientPulse 3.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

        @keyframes breathA {
          0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.5; }
          100% { transform: scale(1.02); opacity: 0.8; }
        }
        @keyframes breathB {
          0% { transform: translateY(0); }
          100% { transform: translateY(-1px); }
        }

        /* Burst */
        .anim-burst .star-stack { animation: burstMorph 3s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) infinite; }
        .anim-burst .ring-1 { animation: burstRing 3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; }
        .anim-burst .ring-2 { animation: burstRing 3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite 0.12s; }
        .anim-burst .core-glow { animation: burstFlash 3s ease-out infinite; }

        @keyframes burstMorph {
          0%, 65%, 100% { transform: scale(1); border-radius: 0%; }
          75% { transform: scale(0.88); filter: brightness(1.3); }
          78% { transform: scale(1.18, 1.18); border-radius: 50%; filter: brightness(1.5); }
          85% { transform: scale(1.05); }
        }
        @keyframes burstRing {
          0%, 70% { transform: scale(0.6); opacity: 0; }
          74% { opacity: 0.6; }
          100% { transform: scale(1.8); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes burstFlash {
          0%, 70%, 100% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.2); }
          77% { opacity: 0.9; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.8); background: white; filter: blur(4px); }
          82% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(2.4); }
        }

        /* Shake */
        .anim-shake .star-stack { animation: organicShake 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) infinite; }
        .anim-shake .main-layer { animation: desatPulse 0.28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
        .anim-shake .core-glow { background: #EF4444; animation: glowPulse 0.28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; opacity: 0.5; }
        .anim-shake .ambient-glow { background: #EF4444 !important; opacity: 0.32 !important; filter: blur(16px) !important; animation: shakeGlow 0.28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

        @keyframes organicShake {
          0% { transform: translateX(0) rotate(0deg); }
          20% { transform: translateX(-1px) rotate(-0.6deg); }
          40% { transform: translateX(1px) rotate(0.6deg) scale(1.02, 0.98); }
          60% { transform: translateX(-0.8px) rotate(-0.3deg); }
          80% { transform: translateX(0.8px) rotate(0.4deg); }
          100% { transform: translateX(0) rotate(0deg); }
        }
        @keyframes desatPulse {
          0% { filter: saturate(1) brightness(1); }
          100% { filter: saturate(0.7) brightness(0.92); }
        }
        @keyframes shakeGlow {
          0% { opacity: 0.22; transform: scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0.42; transform: scale(1.12); }
        }

        /* Wind down */
        .anim-winddown .star-stack { animation: windDown 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) infinite alternate; }
        .anim-winddown .main-layer { animation: windDownFilter 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) infinite alternate; }
        .anim-winddown .ambient-glow { animation: windDownAmbient 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) infinite alternate; }

        @keyframes windDown {
          0% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); filter: blur(0px); opacity: 1; }
          100% { transform: scale(0.85) rotate(-6deg); filter: blur(4px); opacity: 0.55; }
        }
        @keyframes windDownFilter {
          0% { filter: saturate(1) brightness(1); background-position: 0% 50%; }
          100% { filter: saturate(0.15) brightness(0.75); background-position: 100% 50%; }
        }
        @keyframes windDownAmbient {
          0% { opacity: 0.22; transform: scale(1); }
          100% { opacity: 0.06; transform: scale(0.7); }
        }

        /* Shared */
        @keyframes gradientShift {
          0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
          100% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
        }
        @keyframes gradientShiftFast {
          0% { background-position: 0% 50%; filter: brightness(1); }
          100% { background-position: 100% 50%; filter: brightness(1.15); }
        }
        @keyframes glowPulse {
          0% { opacity: 0.3; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.9); }
          100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.25); }
        }
        @keyframes ambientPulse {
          0% { opacity: 0.18; transform: scale(0.96); }
          100% { opacity: 0.32; transform: scale(1.08); }
        }
        @keyframes orbitSlow {
          0% { transform: rotate(0deg) translateX(10px) rotate(0deg); }
          100% { transform: rotate(360deg) translateX(10px) rotate(-360deg); }
        }

        .paused, .paused * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }

        /* Glass card */
        .glass-card {
          background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 100%);
          backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
          border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
          box-shadow: 
            0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08) inset,
            0 8px 32px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6),
            0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset;
          transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
        }
        .glass-card:hover {
          transform: translateY(-4px);
          border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
          box-shadow: 
            0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12) inset,
            0 16px 48px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.7),
            0 0 24px -4px rgba(139,92,246,0.15);
        }
